name: After § 42
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 42a. Expresses deep concern that the Commission has financed or co-financed campaigns promoting the wearing of the headscarf, stating, for example, that ‘freedom is in the hijab’; insists that, in the future, the EU budget must no longer finance any campaign that directly or indirectly promotes the wearing of the headscarf;
